What does it take to make AI change a company rather than become another pilot programme? Stefan Atanassov, co-founder of Infinite Mind, joins us to argue that the decisive work is not choosing a model. It is redesigning processes, roles, skills and governance around the value the company wants to create.

We discuss why CEOs must own the AI narrative, why generic tool rollouts and generic training fail, how role-specific enablement develops real intuition and why scaling needs permissions, security, governance and cost management from the beginning. Stefan also explains why the goal is for AI to become boring: embedded safely in the way work gets done.
